paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the BLEU scores achieved by four different models as a function of Average Lagging (AL) on the IWSLT14 De dataset. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", ranges from 0 to 8 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", ranges from 20 to 32 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 2. Four distinct lines are shown: a purple dashed line with circular markers representing "Consistency-CE", a dark purple dashed line with square markers for "Inconsistency-CE", a blue dashed line with square markers for "Inconsistency-CE-MP", and a red solid line with star markers for "Consistency-Bi". The red line (Consistency-Bi) starts at approximately 26 BLEU at AL=2 and increases steadily to about 32 BLEU at AL=8. The blue line (Inconsistency-CE-MP) begins at around 22 BLEU at AL=2 and rises to approximately 31 BLEU at AL=8. The dark purple line (Inconsistency-CE) starts at about 22 BLEU at AL=2 and reaches roughly 30 BLEU at AL=8. The purple line (Consistency-CE) begins at approximately 20 BLEU at AL=2 and increases to about 30 BLEU at AL=8. All lines show a general upward trend with increasing AL, though the red line consistently achieves the highest BLEU scores across all AL values.
